paragraphs: R' Yaakov bar Acha bar Idi.
Mentioned at the end of Demai, chapter 1, reporting in the name of R' Yehoshua ben Levi. Hyman suggests that the same name should also be read in Moed Katan 27a.[^1]

notes.text: ריב״ל is contextually Yehoshua ben Levi, not the older erroneous Resh Lakish gloss; title component remains R'. ספ״א gives end of chapter 1, without a supplied Demai corpus; כז. gives Moed Katan 27a by the period convention. Neither locus is independently checked. נראה keeps Hyman’s tentative correction at inferential force, not an independently confirmed correct reading. The heading’s double patronymic is whole and its title remains R'.
